title: Discovery-only local tabulated conservative closure screen

predecessor.reason_for_new_family: Stage 1 exposed severe instability from a globally fitted bilinear closure despite nearby same-forcing discovery states. A local table tests whether the problem is global operator identification rather than absence of useful state compression.

purpose: Use only discovery histories to test whether a nonparametric local, forcing-specific transition table can propagate reduced B01 states conservatively and stably enough to justify generation of genuinely new validation histories.

data_authority.reason: H01-H04 have already been exposed by Stage 1 and may not serve as blind evidence for a successor architecture.

candidate_states.definition: total storage plus one contrast between the two contiguous 80-cm theta means
total storage plus three contrasts of contiguous 40-cm theta means relative to the deepest band
total storage plus seven contrasts of contiguous 20-cm theta means relative to the deepest band

closure.training_partition: leave one discovery history out; train on the other seven histories
closure.transition_inputs: accepted reduced state at step k
closure.forcing_identity: exact frozen tuple (u_top,u_bottom,u_head_mode) of target interval k+1
closure.lookup_metric: Euclidean distance after per-coordinate mean/std standardization from the training partition only
closure.storage_update: exact conservative update S_next = S_current - top_exchange - predicted_bottom_outward_exchange

baselines.definition: within each training partition and exact forcing tuple, predict the mean shape increment, bottom exchange and bottom flux independent of state

evaluation.one_step: use the exact target-history state at step k as input
evaluation.recursive: start from exact target-history step 1 and recursively advance steps 2..64

structural_kill_if: any candidate reconstructs theta outside B01 [0.02,0.427494]
any candidate violates the conservative water ledger by more than 1e-12 cm
development_decision.value_screen: A candidate is not considered promising merely because it is stable. It must outperform the forcing-only mean baseline on both recursive cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE and recursive total-storage RMSE over the pooled leave-one-history-out discovery folds.
development_decision.dimension_rule: Prefer the lowest-dimensional candidate that passes the structural gate and the value screen. Event-fidelity metrics remain separately reported and cannot be traded away silently.
development_decision.final_application_acceptance: NOT_ALLOWED_IN_S2D. Any candidate that passes S2D must be frozen before generating new unexposed validation histories and before numerical application thresholds are specified.
